agentAutomation.title: Agent automation
agentAutomation.description: Controls the default authorization mode for Agent write actions. In every mode, long-term memory writes, AI summaries, learning-asset adoption, and external-processing consent still follow their original confirmation rules; switching only affects new chats, and every switch is audited.

mode.REQUEST_APPROVAL: Every write action shows a confirmation card before it runs.
mode.AUTO_APPROVE: Low-risk actions (e.g. creating a course) run automatically with a receipt; destructive actions still confirm one by one.
mode.FULL_ACCESS: Everything except explicitly prohibited actions runs automatically with a receipt.

learnerMemory.title: AI memory
learnerMemory.description: AI only uses the preferences and states listed here to adjust explanations and suggestions. Memories are created in exactly two ways: editing here directly, or confirming a "remember…" proposal in chat. Regular chats are never silently recorded.
learnerMemory.explicitHint: Stable preferences you explicitly told the AI. They take effect immediately and can be edited or removed at any time.
learnerMemory.explicitEmpty: No explicit preferences yet. Add them here, or tell the AI in chat: "remember that I like…".
learnerMemory.explicitPlaceholder: e.g. I like to see worked examples first
learnerMemory.observedHint: Inferred from your structured learning evidence. They only take effect after your confirmation and never override your explicit preferences.
learnerMemory.outboundHintOn: On: when you start a chat, the minimal necessary memory is sent along with the context to the AI service.
learnerMemory.outboundHintOff: Off: memories stay on this device and remain viewable and manageable, but are never sent to the AI service.
learnerMemory.outboundConsentStale: On, but the outbound consent is stale (provider address or key changed). Re-complete the consent in "AI services"; until then memories are not sent.

profile.aboutMePlaceholder: Describe your background and learning goals in a sentence or two, e.g. three years in backend, catching up on operating systems.

dataDirectory.transferDescription: Export all data, or restore an export into an empty library.

dataDirectory.hintDuration: The more data, the longer it takes; keep the app open during migration.

dataDirectory.exportDescription: Packs the database, original files and configuration into a zip saved to the exports folder of the data directory. You can keep using the app while exporting.

dataDirectory.exportDone: Exported: {{fileName}} (in the exports folder of the data directory; reach it via “Open data directory”)
dataDirectory.importDescription: Restores everything in the archive (courses, Records, profile and configuration) into the current data directory. The current directory is an empty database; data is fully usable after the import.
dataDirectory.importHintRestart: The import runs after the app restarts; in-flight jobs resume automatically, nothing to do manually.
dataDirectory.importRestarting: Preparing import; the app will restart shortly…
dataDirectory.importManualRestart: Import is ready. Dev mode skips the automatic restart — stop tauri dev and start the app again; the import completes automatically at launch.
